Definition: from G4116; to widen (literally or figuratively):--make broad, enlarge.
BiblicalUsage: Platyno means to widen, to enlarge, to make broad. Paul says his heart is enlarged toward the Corinthians in 2 Corinthians 6:11, and asks them to be enlarged also in 2 Corinthians 6:13. But the Pharisees enlarge the borders of their garments in Matthew 23:5 — the same widening, for show.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe a heart can be enlarged by love or a garment by pride, and God knows which is which.
